correctness.rationale: The pinned Shrikhande graph S on Z4² has 16 vertices, degree six, SRG parameters (16,6,2,2). Direct independent enumeration gives the Alexander dual f-vector [1,16,120,176,60] and 384 disconnected triples. Its integral cellular chains have d2 image equal to the complete-graph one-cycle lattice with 105 integer unit pivots; d3 has 60 unit pivots and no residual, yielding free H2(dual)=Z11, other reduced dual homology zero. Combined with integral Alexander duality (index 16−j−3) this yields H11(Δ3(S))=Z11. Because the dual has no 5-vertex faces, Δ3 contains the full 10-skeleton of the 15-simplex; its 10-connectivity plus Hurewicz and homology Whitehead imply a wedge of eleven 11-spheres, not merely a Betti calculation. Explicit 16 translations and 12 stabilizing linear maps exhaust Aut(S): the neighborhood-induced 6-cycle bounds vertex stabilizer by 12. Independent signed chain trace computations across all 192 maps give histogram of (trace:count) {11:1,3:9,2:32,1:36,0:32,-1:66,-3:4,-5:12}, sum zero, matching the detailed cycle/trace breakdown. Every ambient permutation is even; equivariant Alexander duality preserves sign. Rational transfer gives zero reduced homology of the orbit space (not contractibility). Rook K4□K4 has different rank27 and was not claimed new.
